acceptanceCriteria: every store-mutating command accepts --lock-wait with the same semantics and bounds as claim, or the Tasks spec names each exception and why
help text and a table-driven test cover the flag on each mutating command
body: Observed 2026-10-16 (build 558). With ~15 orchestrator closeouts running at once, claims hit LOCK_TIMEOUT on taskman.prepare.lock (30 s preparation acquisition, e.g. PR #941's V1-1331 claim). claim, release, renew, submit and attempt heartbeat accept --lock-wait SECONDS; complete, widen, gate run, ticket create, ticket refine, ticket note set, ticket archive and policy update reject it ('unknown flag --lock-wait'), so a supervisor must wrap them in its own retry loop with fresh request IDs. Related: V1-1130 (pool acquire), V1-1150 (pool sweep/reap decision).
title: corvint-tasks: --lock-wait missing on complete, widen, gate run, ticket create/refine/note set/archive and policy update
